persona: Undergraduate genetics student analyzing F2 generation from a dihybrid cross
source_style: hand-counted phenotypes from lab experiment, tallied and entered into Excel

columns.name: Phenotype
columns.notes: Observed phenotype classes: Red/Round, Red/Wrinkled, Yellow/Round, Yellow/Wrinkled

columns.name: Count
columns.notes: Observed count of individuals in each phenotype class

intended_analysis: Goodness-of-fit test (chi-square) comparing observed phenotype distribution to expected 9:3:3:1 Mendelian ratio
mess_applied: counts not raw rows (summary count grid format)
percentage column is derived (not raw data)
what_a_naive_reader_would_get_wrong: A naive reader might not recognize the 9:3:3:1 ratio expectation, might confuse phenotypic categories with genotypic ratios, might treat percentage column as independent raw data rather than derived from counts, or might incorrectly calculate expected counts for the goodness-of-fit test without accounting for the dihybrid cross design
